outcome: HIV RNA copy number in infants
HIV antigen/antibody test results in infants
cohort: Nine infants born to HIV-positive mothers at Korea University Ansan Hospital between June 1, 2003, and May 31, 2013.
finding: This study concludes that prophylactic antiretroviral therapy, scheduled cesarean section, and prohibition of breastfeeding considerably decrease mother-to-child HIV transmission.
mod_finding: Scheduled cesarean section was associated with decreased mother-to-child HIV transmission.
birth_weight: Low birth weight in 33.3% of infants
